prompt: Who was the chief guest of the eighteenth convocation of Indira Gandhi National Open University, New Delhi, held in 2007?
answer: The chief guest was **Justice K. G. Balakrishnan, Chief Justice of India**. The 18th IGNOU convocation was held on **17 March 2007**.
